answer: Seeded admission lottery: each agent identity must solve a challenge seeded by a delayed verifiable random beacon, so the puzzle cannot be precomputed. Because solutions depend on the future beacon, an attacker must run full work per identity at submission time. Basalt-hard memory requirements further cap parallel forging, making mass sybil creation cost real compute plus forfeited deposits per failed slot.
